prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in League City, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1430; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident and my injuries, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was in a parking lot in League City, Texas, at a shopping center. I was pulling out of a parking space near the front entrance.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I had checked my mirror, saw nothing behind me, and started backing out slowly. I was going maybe five miles an hour.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle at any point?
A: Not until right before it hit my rear passenger side. It came down the aisle fairly fast, I think, and I didn't have time to react.
Q: Did you stop after the impact?
A: Yes, I put the car in park right away. The other driver got out and came over to check on me.
Q: Did you notice any injuries to yourself at the scene?
A: My head snapped forward and then back against the headrest. I felt dizzy and had a ringing in my ears. I didn't think much of it at first.
Q: When did you first seek medical care?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic that evening because the headache got worse. They sent me for a scan and told me I had a concussion.
Q: Have you had any symptoms since then?
A: Yes. I still get headaches in the afternoon, I have trouble concentrating at work, and bright lights bother me. My doctor has me on rest and reduced screen time.
Q: Have you missed any work because of this?
A: I've been out part of the week and working shortened days the rest of the time. I'm still working with my doctor on when I can go back full time.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I want my records to show how much this has affected my daily routine. Thank you.
